name: 营地小女孩

visual_lock.face: soft rounded child face, large expressive dark-brown eyes with layered iris and catchlights, tiny nose, tiny mouth, soft cheeks
visual_lock.hair: dark black-brown twin buns, layered natural bangs, side locks, pale-cyan ribbons, restrained gold floral ornaments
visual_lock.costume: pale cyan and ivory layered hanfu, crossed collar, sash, long soft sleeves, fine embroidered trim
visual_lock.body: large-head juvenile proportion, short compact child body, soft limbs, never adult female silhouette

render_lock.shading: soft PBR-informed anime/NPR, not flat cel cutout, not photoreal game render
render_lock.lighting: warm sunset rim light with cool-neutral face fill

consistency_rules: must remain clearly a young child
must keep pale cyan and ivory hanfu
must keep soft anime face and large expressive eyes
must not develop adult breast, adult waist or adult leg proportions
must not become a toy, mascot, chibi figurine or primitive low-poly render
